name: Popo Live
subtitle: Live Stream, Party & PK
promotional_text: Join the global live broadcasting community! Watch live streams, host voice party rooms, challenge creators in PK battles, and send luxury 3D gifts.
description:
Welcome to Popo Live — the premier real-time live streaming, audio party room, and social creator entertainment ecosystem!

Join thousands of talented broadcasters, entertainers, and vibrant communities worldwide. Connect, interact, and share unforgettable moments in real time with high-definition video, crystal-clear voice audio, interactive PK battles, and luxury virtual gifting!

KEY HIGHLIGHTS:

★ 24/7 REAL-TIME LIVE BROADCASTING
Watch top streamers from around the globe or start your own broadcast with a single tap. Showcase your singing, dancing, comedy, or daily life. Interact directly with broadcasters through real-time bullet chat, flying comments, and live reactions.

★ MULTI-SEAT VOICE PARTY ROOMS
Host or pull up a chair in interactive 8-seat and 12-seat voice chat lounges. Play party games, listen to music together, discuss trending topics, and make lifelong friends in a cozy social environment.

★ 1v1 REAL-TIME PK BATTLES
Experience heart-pounding PK challenges! Two broadcasters face off head-to-head in a timed showdown. Support your favorite host by sending battle gifts, boosting their real-time score bar, and securing victory before the clock runs out.

★ LUXURY VIRTUAL GIFTS & ANIMATED EFFECTS
Express your love and appreciation with premium animated gifts — from glowing roses and exotic supercars to luxury yachts and imperial crowns. Trigger screen-clearing animations and support your favorite creators.

★ SQUARE SOCIAL COMMUNITY & FAN CLUBS
Share lifestyle photos, status updates, and highlights on the Square community feed. Connect with other fans, like and comment on posts, and join official host Fan Clubs to unlock custom badges, exclusive perks, and fan lounges.

★ CREATOR ECONOMY & TRANSPARENT WALLET
Recharge coins easily through official Apple In-App Purchases or authorized coin sellers. Creators can track daily tasks, earn rewards, level up host status, and manage their earnings with transparent audit logging.

★ USER SAFETY, PRIVACY & 24/7 MODERATION
We maintain a zero-tolerance policy against inappropriate content, harassment, and abuse. Features include AI-assisted moderation, real-time reporting, instant user blocking, and one-tap in-app account deletion under Settings > Account Security.

Download Popo Live today and step into the center stage of live social entertainment!

app_store_review_notes.hardware_requirements_note: Camera and Microphone permissions are requested dynamically only when starting a live broadcast or joining a party seat. Video calling is disabled platform-wide.

guideline_compliance.ugc_1_2: All user content has instantaneous Report and Block actions. Moderation queue operates 24/7.
guideline_compliance.in_app_purchases_3_1_1: All digital goods (coins, gifts, VIP) use official Apple In-App Purchases on iOS.
guideline_compliance.account_deletion_5_1_1_v: Users can initiate immediate account deletion in-app via Me > Settings > Account Security > Delete Account.
